title: Decision Priority Policy
description: Machine-readable priority classification for Factory verifier decisions. Defines P0 hard floor failures, P1 blocking caveats, and P2 non-blocking caveats with their escalation and remediation rules.

P0.label: Hard Floor Failure
P0.description: A binary gate that must pass for phase closure. Failure blocks all downstream phases.
examples: Worker contract scope violation detected by cross-scope audit.
SCORING_SYSTEM_GATE triggered: score-based PASS substituted for verifier evidence.
Undeclared Main Agent fallback writing worker-owned scope.
Generic FAIL emitted with no specific target gate reference.
Hard floor complexity threshold not met (files < minimum, exports < minimum).
P0.verifierRequirement: Must be detected by an automated verifier with machine-readable JSON output.
P0.escalation: Immediately blocks factoryctl phase-close. Requires explicit repair agent respawn.

P1.label: Blocking Caveat
P1.description: A non-binary issue that must be repaired before phase closure but does not invalidate completed work.
P1.remediationWindow: Must be repaired before phase-close; can be repaired in same session.
examples: Evidence entry missing transcriptRef but has verifier JSON.
Progress event with missing evidenceRefs for non-trivial operation.
Worker contract missing declared dependency that exists in practice.
Allowed import not declared in contract but discovered by static analysis.
Session rotation handoff exists but was generated before last evidence write.
P1.verifierRequirement: Verifier must enumerate specific missing items; repair agent must address each.
P1.escalation: Blocks factoryctl phase-close until all P1 items are resolved. Repair agent can resolve in-place.

P2.label: Non-Blocking Caveat
P2.description: An advisory finding recorded in the phase close report. Does not block phase closure.
P2.remediationWindow: Recorded for next phase awareness; may be addressed opportunistically.
examples: Evidence entry missing optional size field.
Progress event timestamp granularity below microsecond.
Worker contract missing generatedBy field for retroactive contracts.
Non-critical documentation gap in verifier module spec.
Negative fixture template has unused optional fields.
P2.verifierRequirement: Verifier must log P2 findings; no repair agent required.
P2.escalation: Recorded in phase-close audit log. Automatically surfaced to next phase integrator.

classificationRules.contractDeclarationIncomplete: P1 if dependency is used in practice; P2 if declaration-only gap.
classificationRules.contextCompressionExceeded: P1 if >2 compressions; P2 if exactly 2.

antiAbuseRules.noCaveatDowngradeOfP0: A P0 failure cannot be reclassified as P1 or P2 by caveat. The classification is immutable.
antiAbuseRules.noScoreBasedReclassification: A computed score (0.0-1.0) cannot override priority classification.
antiAbuseRules.noManualOverrideWithoutVerifier: Manual priority override requires a verifier result confirming the reclassification basis.
antiAbuseRules.noSilentDowngrade: Any priority downgrade must be recorded in the phase-close report with explicit rationale.
